name: angular-expressjs-openapi-monorepo
description: Monorepo containing Angular 19 frontend and Express.js OpenAPI backend

scripts.build:frontend: echo 'Angular build will be configured after Angular installation'
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev:frontend: echo 'Angular dev server will be configured after Angular installation'
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && cd backend && npm run clean
